name: Snakebite (d20pfsrd)
body:
Aura strong divination; CL 12th; Slot none; Price 180,350 gp Weight 4 lbs.

Alignment LN; ego 19
Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +12 Int 12, Wis 14, Cha 16
Communication telepathy
Languages Common, Draconic
Powers fly 30 ft., 10 ranks in Perception
Special Purpose defeat/slay serpentfolk; Dedicated Power true seeing at will

DESCRIPTION

Snakebite is a lawful-aligned intelligent +2 mithral monstrous humanoid bane greatsword that can resize to fit the hands of its wielder.

Snakebite was made for a great cyclops general with the specific purpose of slaying serpentfolk and their agents wherever they might be found. The sword’s knowledge and experience was invaluable against the serpentfolk, and its disappearance (along with the general) somewhere beneath the jungles was a great loss.
